title: Speed from distance and time
prompt: The robot moved distance pixels during a frame that lasted delta seconds. Return its speed in pixels per second. 2 pixels in 0.5 s is 4 per second.
starter:
func solve(distance, delta) -> float:
	return distance * delta
hints: The opposite of the first problem in this topic.
solution:
func solve(distance, delta) -> float:
	return distance / delta
